name: Laureth-12
description: Laureth-12 (CAS 3056-00-6 ), also supplied under designations such as PEG-12 Lauryl Ether and LIPOCOL L-12, is a nonionic ethoxylated fatty alcohol used across personal care and industrial formulations. It functions primarily as an emulsifier, surfactant, and mild cleansing agent, offering good compatibility with a broad range of active ingredients and co-surfactants in various chemical systems. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetic formulations, including shampoos, body washes, and skin creams, it stabilizes oil-in-water emulsions and contributes mild moisturizing properties to the final product. Industrial and household cleaning products use it as a low-foam or controlled-foam surfactant for degreasing hard surfaces and formulating concentrated cleaners for heavy-duty applications. Textile processing relies on it as an emulsifying and wetting agent during dyeing, scouring, and finishing operations. In leather treatment, it supports uniform penetration of conditioning agents. Laureth-12 is typically supplied as a liquid or semi-solid paste, depending on temperature and concentration. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications for manufacturers. Standard packaging includes drums and IBCs for bulk procurement. This versatile chemical ensures stability and performance across diverse personal care, textile, and industrial manufacturing sectors.
